rectSubtitle: Estimate an uncertain birth time from life events
rectIntro: If you know your birth time only roughly, Drishti can check which times in a range fit your major life events best, using traditional dasha and transit rules.
rectNeedsDatePlace: Rectification needs a birth date and birthplace in this profile.
rectEventsInfo: Add dated events you are sure about. Three or more give more meaningful results.
rectApplied: Birth time set to {time} and marked approximate.
rectCaveat: Rectification is an estimate based on traditional rules, not a measurement. Different astrologers use different methods and may reach different times. Prefer a recorded birth time (hospital or family records) whenever you have one.
rectNoMatch: No reasons found for this event at this time.
